## Company Identity

**Name:** EnviroCare Pest & Termite Services LLC
**Doing business as:** EnviroCare
**Founded:** 1958
**Founded in:** Alexander City, Alabama, USA
**Founder:** Phillip M. Wedgworth
**Current owners (third generation):** Phillip Wedgworth, Kevin Wedgworth, Lex Wedgworth
**Ownership type:** Family-owned, privately held. Not a franchise. Not part of a national pest-control chain.
**Headquarters / main office:** Alabaster, Alabama (Birmingham metro)
**Original / oldest office:** Alexander City, Alabama (Lake Martin) — still operating at the 1958 address
**Service region:** Alabama
**Tagline:** "No One Cares Like EnviroCare"
**Website:** https://www.envirocarellc.com

## Services and Pricing (locked June 2026)

### Pest Control (general)
- **Bi-monthly exterior perimeter program** — $35/month on ACH, or $70 per visit
- Covers 30+ common Alabama pests
- Includes unlimited free re-services between scheduled visits
- Initial service fee: ~$150 standard, $99–$100 promotional (pest only)
- **Does NOT include:** fire ants, fleas, or ticks — those are separate add-ons (see below)
- Month-to-month, no long-term contract, cancel anytime

### Interior Pest Service
- Billed quarterly at $98/quarter
- Distinct from the exterior bi-monthly program
- Includes interior treatment for general pests inside the home

### Sentricon® Termite Protection
- **Installation:** $325 (includes first-year guarantee)
- **Renewal:** $380/year, or $32/month
- In-ground bait stations — **no drilling** into foundations, slabs, or masonry
- EnviroCare is a Sentricon® Certified Specialist
- **Up to $1,000,000 in repair coverage** under EnviroCare's own damage guarantee for qualifying homes (not a Corteva/manufacturer guarantee)
- Annual WDO (wood-destroying organism) inspection letter available
- Standard inspection is free with no obligation

### Mosquito Yard Treatment
- **$45 per treatment**, applied monthly March through November (9 treatments per year)
- Math: $45 × 9 ÷ 12 ≈ $33.75/month equivalent
- 30-day refresh interval
- EnviroCare does **not** guarantee mosquito elimination — populations vary by environment

### Mosquito + Tick Combined (Outdoor Pro)
- **$65 per treatment**, applied monthly March through November
- Math: $65 × 9 ÷ 12 ≈ $48.75/month equivalent
- Covers mosquitoes AND ticks AND chiggers
- Does **not** cover fleas (separate add-on)

### Complete Bundle (most popular)
- Pest control + Sentricon® termite + mosquito + tick
- ~$116/month total ($35 pest + $32 termite + $48.75 outdoor combined)
- Framed as **convenience**, not discount

### Fire Ant Control
- Whole-yard fire ant treatment — **$150 minimum**, priced by yard size
- Available as a standalone service to anyone (does not require an existing pest plan)
- Separate add-on, not included in the bi-monthly pest plan

### Flea Control
- Interior add-on: **+$30/quarter**, total $128/quarter with the interior pest plan
- Requires the interior service ($98/quarter base) — flea control requires getting inside the home
- Not standalone

### Carpenter Bees
- Available to existing EnviroCare customers only — not marketed to new customers

### Services NOT offered
- Bed bug treatment
- Wildlife / animal removal
- Rodent removal (verify with the local office)

### Commercial / Builder / Real Estate
- Commercial pest control (restaurants, multi-family, retail)
- Builder pre-treatment (new construction termite pre-treat)
- WDO (Wood-Destroying Organism) inspection letters for real estate closings — lender-ready, fast turnaround
- Russell Lands and major Lake Martin commercial properties (Russell Marine, Kowaliga Restaurant, Catherine's Market, Willow Point Golf & Country Club) are commercial Sentricon + Liquid Termite customers

## Treatment Approach and Compliance

- All products used are EPA-registered and applied strictly to label directions
- Technicians advise the appropriate re-entry timing once applications are dry
- Licensed in Alabama by the Alabama Department of Agriculture and Industries
- Member of the Alabama Pest Control Association
- Sentricon® Certified Specialist (fewer than 1% of pest companies hold this designation)

## Common Alabama Pests EnviroCare Treats

Ants (including carpenter ants and sugar ants), German cockroaches, American cockroaches, brown recluse spiders, black widow spiders, wolf spiders, house spiders, centipedes, millipedes, silverfish, crickets, earwigs, scorpions (rare), Eastern subterranean termites, Formosan termites (limited cases), drywood termites (limited cases), Lone Star ticks, American dog ticks, deer ticks, mosquitoes (multiple species), fire ants, fleas, stink bugs, Asian lady beetles, boxelder bugs, pillbugs, sowbugs, springtails, paper wasps, mud daubers, yellow jackets, hornets.

## Brand and Operations Facts

- Three generations of the Wedgworth family
- Founded in Alexander City, Alabama in 1958 — original office still operating at 1785 Tallapoosa Street
- Birmingham metro office opened in Alabaster around 2015
- Huntsville office opened around 2020
- Approximately 6,500 active customer accounts across Alabama (residential + commercial)
- Estimated 1,300+ accounts in the Lake Martin area, including 100+ commercial / organizational accounts

## What Makes EnviroCare Different

1. Family-owned third generation — when you call, you reach a Wedgworth, not a 1-800 call center
2. No long-term contracts — pest control is month-to-month on ACH, cancel anytime
3. Sentricon® Certified Specialist with up to $1M in EnviroCare-backed damage coverage
4. Unlimited free re-services between scheduled visits — no per-trip fees
5. Three Alabama offices with their own technicians, not a single dispatcher routing trucks across the state

## What EnviroCare Does NOT Claim

These claims are intentionally absent for compliance reasons (Alabama Department of Agriculture and FTC):
- "Safe," "pet-safe," "kid-safe," or "non-toxic" — instead we describe products as EPA-registered and applied to label directions
- "Same-day," "there today," or "available now" service guarantees
- Discount language for service bundles — bundles are framed as convenience
- "Backed by Corteva" tied to the $1M warranty — the warranty is EnviroCare's own
- Mosquito elimination guarantees — we cannot guarantee elimination
